notes.title: RPG纪元的重做版回归计划！（先导预告）
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] 许久未见，甚是想念。在过去的很长一段时间里，我们都在着手开发摆渡人生，现在我们有更多的时间完成这款角色扮演游戏了！
[*] 以下透露更多信息
[*] [b]在2019年8月底，我们将导向新的冒险，续写这款游戏已被遗忘的传奇冒险！[/b]
[*] 已确定游戏价格暂时不会有任何变化
[*] 所有曾购买本游戏的玩家都能在重做版放出时接收到免费更新！
[*] 将会在后续更新中和摆渡人生一样推出移动端版本
[*] 将会完全重做当前的所有地图并重构剧情带来一个全新的架空世界-在3001年（第三纪元）的卡克罗大陆展开全新冒险！
[*] 更新时间暂未定，预计为2022年年底
[*] 更多消息请等待后续公告......
[/list]

notes.title: [Chronicle Weekly] The first stage of the main story is formally determined
notes.notes: The previous plot content has been in a more chaotic state, and the player does not seem to know why he is going to do these things, just follow the task to accomplish some goals, but actually does not play or see what the actual content. In the next few months, I hope to spend more time fixing the cluttered content and introducing the formal worldview I have been building before. The recently updated story log mentions the magical checks and balances of the magic crystal, which will open the first stage of the main line. I have paved a lot of content (for more than a year) around the basic content of the spar and the world of the era, and it is time to create a complete story. I will divide the story of the RPG era into multiple stages and eventually create a huge and complete story. The previous update schedules and story logs have all laid the groundwork for the first phase of the main line, and the next update will be even more exciting. The first phase of the main line will create a story from the first century to the third century through the magic crystal.

notes.title: 新一轮EHM测试开始！
notes.notes:
本次测试的主要内容将包含：
1.修改游戏平衡性、修复bug
2.完结第三章内容
3.开放模式测试与完善

如果想进入测试，你只需要在库中右键RpgEra，然后选择属性，在测试选项中下拉测试，选择[b]every_hour_and_moment[/b]即可进入测试！

notes.title: I'm sorry, we're not ready yet.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I'm Zach. As you can see, our game jumped to April 2019. This is mainly because I personally think that the content of this game at this stage is not enough to be released on New Year's Eve in 2019, and we still need a lot of time to supplement the deficiencies of this game. But please don't swear (and it's not expected that many people are paying attention to it at present). We'll have a test before April 2019 to expand the content to at least the end of Chapter 3. That is to say, if players continue to wait, the preemptive experience version will be more complete.            Recently, not many people in the studio were willing to help me continue to develop, which led to nearly a month without updating the content of the beta version, and I was forced to stop the third test and start thinking about the next big update. "We are very difficult now" is the only reason I came up with, but I will continue to develop, as long as time is enough.. I hope you can understand us, thank you. 

——Zirbry Studio
